Extramammary Paget’s disease (EMPD) is a rare cutaneous adenocarcinoma with no established standard systemic therapy owing to limited clinical evidence. Approximately 40% of metastatic EMPD cases overexpress human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2), suggesting a potential therapeutic target. However, prospective evidence for HER2-directed antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) in advanced EMPD is lacking.
